voice.subtitle: A professional voice assistant that listens, confirms your goal, and builds your personal roadmap.
voice.notSupported: Voice recognition is not available in this browser.
voice.ready: Welcome to DAARI. Start listening when you are ready to begin.
voice.placeholder: For example: I know Excel and SQL. I want a data operations job in Guntur.
voice.noGoal: I could not identify a supported career goal. Try saying a role such as data entry, customer support, retail sales, delivery, or data analyst.
voice.welcome: Welcome to DAARI. I am your career advisor. What is your name?
voice.askName: Welcome to DAARI. I am your career advisor. What is your name?
voice.nameRetry: I did not catch your name. Please say, my name is, followed by your name.
voice.askProfile: Thank you, {name}. Please tell me what skills you know and the career you want to become.
voice.confirmRoadmap: Thank you, {name}. You said: {recap}. I understood your goal as {goal}, with these skills: {skills}. Would you like me to create your roadmap? Please say yes or no.
voice.askConfirmation: Would you like me to create your roadmap? Please say yes or no.
voice.changeRequest: Certainly. Please tell me again about your skills and the career you want.
voice.building: I am building your personalized roadmap now.
voice.roadmapCreated: Yes, {name}. I have built a professional roadmap for your goal of becoming a {goal}. Opening it now.
voice.roadmapError: I could not build the roadmap right now. Please tell me your goal and skills once more.
voice.traceProfile: Name: {name} → listening for skills and career goal
